name: Pakistan Affairs · Partition & Early Years (1947–1958)
title: Pakistan Affairs · Partition & Early Years (1947–1958)
subtitle: Practice bank topic · 61 MCQs
answerKeyNote: Practice answer key (not an official FPSC key). Keys were cross-checked and corrected where needed; items marked Low confidence are noted in the explanation.
source: https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies (topic chapters: history, constitution, geography, economy, foreign relations, culture)
Key checks: na.gov.pk / Constitution Art. 51 (NA seats), Wikipedia & Gazette of India 17 Aug 1947 (Radcliffe Award), cabinet.gov.pk 1958 cabinet list (Bhutto as Commerce Minister)

questions.text: Junagadh was a small maritime sate and had an area of ________.
questions.explanation: Answer: 8643 sq km. Source: CSS 2006 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2006/).

questions.text: Radcliffe Commission submitted its formula for the division of India in to two countries to Lord Mountbatton on ______.
questions.explanation: Low confidence: the Radcliffe Award was handed over on 12 August 1947 and published on 17 August, so none of the given dates fits. Source: CSS 2007 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2007/).

questions.text: Liaquat Ali Khan, the first Prime Minister of Pakistan, while addressing a meeting at Rawalpindi was assassinated on __________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Oct 16, 1951. Source: CSS 2007 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2007/).

questions.text: “Pakistan’s Constitution should incorporate the essential principles of Islam, which are as good and relevant in our day, as were 1300 years ago. But Pakistan should not be a theocratic state ruled by priests.” This statement was given by:
questions.explanation: Answer: Quaid-e-Azam. Source: CSS 2008 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2008/).

questions.text: Objective Resolution was passed by the Constituent Assembly of Pakistan on _______________.
questions.explanation: Answer: March 12, 1949. Source: CSS 2008 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2008/).

questions.text: Which provincial Chief Minister was dismissed on the issue of One Unit?
questions.explanation: Answer: Chief Minister Sindh. Source: CSS 2009 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2009/).

questions.text: Which Radio Station already existed at the time of creation of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: Peshawar. Source: CSS 2009 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2009/).

questions.text: When was the state of Swat included in Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: 28th July 1969. Source: CSS 2009 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2009/).

questions.text: Who presided over the session of Constituent Assembly of Pakistan 10 August 1947?
questions.explanation: Answer: Jogendra Nath Mandal. Source: CSS 2009 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2009/).

questions.text: When Abu ala Maududi was awarded death punishment by military court on 'Qadiani issue'?
questions.explanation: Answer: May 1953. Source: CSS 2010 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2010/).

questions.text: Muhammad Ali Bogra, the then P.M of Pakistan, presented his constitutional formula to the Constituent Assembly on _______.
questions.explanation: Answer: Oct 7,1953. Source: CSS 2010 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2010/).

questions.text: By whom the formula of 3rd June 1947 to divide India was announced?
questions.explanation: Answer: Lord Mount Batten. Source: CSS 2012 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2012/).

questions.text: Who was the first president of Constituent Assembly of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: Quaid-e-Azam. Source: CSS 2012 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2012/).

questions.text: Under whom leadership the Constitution of 1956 was passed?
questions.explanation: Answer: Ch. Muhammad Ali. Source: CSS 2012 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2012/).

questions.text: Islamabad was declared capital of Pakistan in ______.
questions.explanation: Note: Islamabad was chosen as capital in 1959–60 (Rawalpindi interim); it formally became the federal capital in 1967. Source: CSS 2013 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2013/).

questions.text: Who dissolved the first constituent assembly of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: Malik Ghulam Muhammad. Source: CSS 2014 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2014/).

questions.text: When did Quaid-e-Azam address the First Constituent Assembly of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: 11th August, 1947. Source: CSS 2014 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2014/).

questions.text: Who wanted to become the joint Governor General of both India and Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: Lord Mount Batten. Source: CSS 2014 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2014/).

questions.text: The British Parliament announced the Independence Act on __________.
questions.explanation: Answer: 18 July 1947. Source: CSS 2015 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2015/).

questions.text: India cut off the flow of canal waters to West Punjab for first time on _______.
questions.explanation: Answer: 1st April 1948. Source: CSS 2015 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2015/).

questions.text: The first Foreign Minister of Pakistan was ______________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Sir Zafrullah Khan. Source: CSS 2015 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2015/).

questions.text: Who was Pakistan’s first law Minister and interim head of the constituent assembly?
questions.explanation: Answer: Jogendra Nath Mandal. Source: CSS 2016 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2016/).

questions.text: Who helped Liaquat Ali Khan to make Objective resolution?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maulana Shabbir Ahmad Usmani. Source: CSS 2016 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2016/).

questions.text: Who led funeral Prayers of Quaid-e-Azam?
questions.explanation: Answer: Moulana Shabbir Ahmad Usmani. Source: CSS 2017 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2017/).

questions.text: Who was the First Commander-in-Chief of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: Frank Messervy. Source: CSS 2018 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2018/).

questions.text: Who was the first Chief Minister of Sindh after independence?
questions.explanation: Answer: Muhammad Ayub Khuhro. Source: CSS 2018 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2018/).

questions.text: Who was the 2nd Governor General of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: Sir Khawaja Nazimuddin. Source: CSS 2019 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2019/).

questions.text: The Bogra formula which was presented on 7th Oct 1953, is also called ______________.
questions.explanation: Low confidence: the formula is generally known simply as the Bogra Formula / Constitutional Formula. Source: CSS 2021 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2021/).

questions.text: PRODA (Public Representative Office Disqualification Act) was passed in?
questions.explanation: Answer: JANUARY 1949. Source: CSS 2022 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2022/).

questions.text: Which act ended the British rule in India?
questions.explanation: Answer: 1947. Source: CSS 2022 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2022/).

questions.text: Who was the first Governor of Punjab after Independence?
questions.explanation: Answer: SIR ROBERT FRANCIS MUDIE. Source: CSS 2022 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2022/).

questions.text: The First Constituent Assembly of Pakistan was dissolved By Governor General Malik Ghulam Muhammad on ?
questions.explanation: The First Constituent Assembly of Pakistan was dissolved by Governor General Malik Ghulam Muhammad on October 24, 1954. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/initial-constitution-making-hurdles) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: What was the purpose of the 1947 constituent assembly?
questions.explanation: The 1947 Constituent Assembly of Pakistan served a dual purpose: Legislative and Constituent. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/initial-constitution-making-hurdles) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: The inaugural meeting of the first constituent assembly was held on:
questions.explanation: The inaugural meeting of the first Constituent Assembly of Pakistan was held on 10th August 1947. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/initial-constitution-making-hurdles) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: How many members were there in the First Constituent Assembly of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The First Constituent Assembly of Pakistan originally had 69 members. Note: the first Constituent Assembly began with 69 members (later raised to 79). Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/initial-constitution-making-hurdles).

questions.text: According to Article of the Constitution of Pakistan, steps shall be taken to enable the Muslims of Pakistan, individually and collectively to order their lives under the fundamental principles and basic facilities whereby they may be enabled to _?

options.A: Promote Islamic culture and heritage worldwide
options.B: Achieve economic prosperity through Islamic banking
options.C: Establish a federal system based on Islamic jurisprudence
options.D: Understand the meaning of life according to the Holy Quran and Sunnah

questions.explanation: The Constitution of Pakistan mandates that steps be taken to enable Muslims to understand the meaning of life according to the Holy Quran and Sunnah. Note: this is Article 31 (Islamic way of life) of the 1973 Constitution. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/initial-constitution-making-hurdles).

questions.text: When was the Committee of Basic Principles formed?
questions.explanation: The Committee of Basic Principles was formed on March 12, 1949 to draft the fundamental principles for Pakistan's future constitution. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/initial-constitution-making-hurdles).

questions.text: Which Act provides the base for constitution of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The Government of India Act, 1935 provided the constitutional foundation for Pakistan until its first constitution was adopted in 1956. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/initial-constitution-making-hurdles).

questions.text: What type(s) of writ was/were issued by the Sindh Chief Court in the case of 'Federation of Pakistan vs. Maulvi Tamizuddin Khan'?
questions.explanation: The Sindh Chief Court issued writs of Mandamus and Quo Warranto in the case of Federation of Pakistan vs. Maulvi Tamizuddin Khan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/initial-constitution-making-hurdles).

questions.text: Pakistan purchased Gwadar from Muscat (Oman) in which year?
questions.explanation: Pakistan purchased Gwadar from Muscat (Oman) in 1958 during the era of President Iskander Mirza. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/miscellaneous-early-problems-state-building-1947-1958) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Who founded Jamat-e-Islami?
questions.explanation: Jamat-e-Islami was founded by Syed Abul Ala Maududi in 1941. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/miscellaneous-early-problems-state-building-1947-1958) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: What was the original capital of Pakistan before it was moved to Islamabad in 1967?
questions.explanation: The original capital of Pakistan was Karachi, which served as the capital from 1947 until it was replaced by Islamabad in 1967. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/miscellaneous-early-problems-state-building-1947-1958).

questions.text: Which political party was banned in Pakistan in 1954?
questions.explanation: The Communist Party was banned in Pakistan in 1954 under the orders of the central government led by Prime Minister Muhammad Ali Bogra. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/miscellaneous-early-problems-state-building-1947-1958).

questions.text: In which year were provincial elections held in East Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Corrected key: the East Bengal provincial elections were held in March 1954, when the United Front routed the Muslim League. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/miscellaneous-early-problems-state-building-1947-1958).

questions.text: Which document was first drafted to accelerate the constitution-making process in Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The Objectives Resolution was the first document drafted to accelerate the constitution-making process in Pakistan, passed by the Constituent Assembly on March 12, 1949. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/objective-resolution-1949) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Who presented the Objectives Resolution in the Constituent Assembly of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The Objectives Resolution was presented by Liaquat Ali Khan in the Constituent Assembly of Pakistan on March 7, 1949. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/objective-resolution-1949) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: According to the Objective Resolution of 1949, to whom does sovereignty belong?
questions.explanation: According to the Objective Resolution of 1949, sovereignty belongs to Allah alone. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/objective-resolution-1949) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: The Objectives Resolution emphasized the adoption of which way of life for Muslims?

options.A: Socialist way of life based on equality
options.C: Secular way of life with religious freedom
options.D: Muslim way of life according to Quran and Sunnah

questions.explanation: The Objectives Resolution emphasized that Muslims shall be enabled to order their lives in accordance with the Muslim way of life according to Quran and Sunnah. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/objective-resolution-1949).

questions.text: After the abolition of One Unit Scheme, in which year did Sindh regain the Provincial Status?
questions.explanation: After the abolition of the One Unit Scheme, Sindh regained its provincial status in 1970. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/one-unit-scheme).

questions.text: When was the One Unit Scheme implemented by merging all four provinces and states of West Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The One Unit Scheme was implemented in 1955, merging all four provinces and princely states of West Pakistan into a single administrative unit. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/one-unit-scheme).

questions.text: What was the status of Bahawalpur immediately before the formation of One Unit in West Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Immediately before the formation of One Unit in West Pakistan, Bahawalpur had the status of a Province. Note: Bahawalpur was given provincial status in 1952 and merged into One Unit in 1955. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/one-unit-scheme).

questions.text: When Balochistan state became a part of the West Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Balochistan became part of West Pakistan on 14 October 1955 under the One Unit Scheme. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/one-unit-scheme).

questions.text: One Unit Bill was passed in which year?
questions.explanation: The One Unit Bill was passed in 1955, merging all provinces of West Pakistan into a single administrative unit. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/one-unit-scheme).

questions.text: At the time of partition, which country received the Muslim-majority districts of Gurdaspur and Ferozepur?
questions.explanation: At the time of partition, the Muslim-majority districts of Gurdaspur and Ferozepur were awarded to India. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/partition-crisis-migration) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Redcliff award was given in which date and time?
questions.explanation: Corrected key: the Radcliffe Award was made public on 17 August 1947 (it had been handed over on 12–13 August). Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/partition-crisis-migration) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Which princely state was the first to formally accede to Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The princely state of Bahawalpur was the first to formally accede to Pakistan, doing so on 7 October 1947. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/partition-crisis-migration) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Who inaugurated the State Bank of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The State Bank of Pakistan was inaugurated by Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah on July 1, 1948. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/quaid-e-azam-liaquat-ali-khan-era) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Rawalpindi Conspiracy Case was unearthed in which year?
questions.explanation: The Rawalpindi Conspiracy Case was unearthed in 1951. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/quaid-e-azam-liaquat-ali-khan-era) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: What is the name of the site in Rawalpindi where Liaquat Ali Khan was assassinated?
questions.explanation: Liaquat Ali Khan was assassinated at Liaquat Bagh in Rawalpindi on October 16, 1951. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/quaid-e-azam-liaquat-ali-khan-era).

questions.text: Who served as the Prime Minister of Pakistan immediately after the country's independence?
questions.explanation: The first Prime Minister of Pakistan immediately after independence was Liaquat Ali Khan, who took office on 15 August 1947. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/quaid-e-azam-liaquat-ali-khan-era).

questions.text: Who was given the title of 'Madar-e-Millat' in Pakistan's history?
questions.explanation: Fatima Jinnah was given the title of 'Madar-e-Millat' (Mother of the Nation) for her unwavering support to her brother Quaid-e-Azam and her contributions to the Pakistan Movement. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/quaid-e-azam-liaquat-ali-khan-era).
